name: 磁吸透明防摔手机壳款

shots.intent: 在搜索结果缩略图里一眼赢下点击，交代正壳、保护膜与磁吸背壳三件套。
把摔机瞬间的恐惧具象化，用撞地一角与护盾光膜给出防摔购买理由。
shots.textZone: upper band for 「{selling_point_1}」, right rail for 「{callout_1}」

shots.intent: 用一列可装与三张不可装机型剪影杜绝买错型号，退掉率立减。
用镜头圈与屏幕沿两道加高围边的微距导引证明全包防护机制。
用充电器盘隔着壳吸合发光的瞬间讲清磁吸对位与无线快充兼容。
以单手持握的真实触感配合三枚留白抗污图标，传递透明背板的日常手感。
收口促单，用侧边纤薄轮廓与空白增量标尺打消戴壳变厚的顾虑。

style.backgroundSystem: seamless cool white #FFFFFF sweep for the opening packshot, deep slate-blue #16324F gradient stage for protection and magnetic screens, light steel #DDE5EC field for detail and fit boards, warm mist grey #E8E4DE only in the closing slim-profile frame
style.direction: technical dark-blue phone case commerce with orange accent callouts
style.iconSystem: thin white circle-slash icons and blank indicator pills on hairline leader lines, one empty check disc and empty cross discs, no certification marks, no rating stars
style.lightingSystem: cool high-key studio light near 6500K with one crisp edge rim tracing the bumper curve, controlled specular streaks on the translucent back, a soft cyan halo glow only where the magnetic charger attaches, never warm tungsten
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent technical dark-blue phone case ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless cool white #FFFFFF, graphite shell #22262C, deep slate-blue stage #16324F and signal-orange accent #F26A1B; cool high-key studio light near 6500K with one crisp edge rim along the bumper and a soft cyan halo only at the magnetic contact; white sweep, brushed dark laminate and matte steel boards only, fractured rubble confined to the single drop frame, no wood, no linen, no pastel stages; one bold grotesque headline kept as empty placeholder slots with at most one orange lead word; thin white circle-slash icons and blank pills on hairline leader lines; stable camera plateau silhouette with a blank dark glass screen and a plain open magnet ring; no color palette changes, no readable clock digits, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting.
noDrift: no readable clock digits or interface icons on screen
style.presentationRules: the cased phone keeps one consistent three-lens camera plateau silhouette and matte translucent back in every frame, the screen always reads as a blank dark glass with no clock or icons, the magnet ring stays a plain open ring with no logo
style.surfaceSystem: glossy seamless white sweep, brushed dark laminate ledges, fractured glass rubble confined to the single drop frame, matte steel info boards, no wood, no linen
style.typography: one bold grotesque headline in white with at most one signal-orange #F26A1B lead word, every headline, pill and scale slot kept as an empty placeholder
